ratings_why.fun: Watching one shared Recipe grow line by line, then pouring it on a lamp unit or another tribe's carry, is a satisfying build you would happily draft.
ratings_why.distinct: A single growing spell that every card writes into and that also fires in fights is fresh, though it sits close to Battlegrounds' 'your spells get stronger' scaling.

verdict_why: The core reads well, but the Herald's 'every other' wording and Drawn's missing duration are real reading fixes worth one pass.

points.text: The Herald's 'every other friendly unit' reads as alternate units; say 'every friendly unit except this one'.
Drawn doesn't say whether its gain is permanent from a Phial and fight-only from Psyche or the Herald, or whether it fires when the Drawn unit itself is the target; one clause each would settle it.
The Recipe is the tribe; show it as a labelled jar on screen with one line per apprentice who wrote it, so players read it like the master's recipe the seed describes.
Old Carbonaria is only a counter; the peppered moth's 'change colour to fit the times' could be her rewriting one Recipe line each turn.
Mortar Grinder and Honeysuckle Nurse are generic 'after a spell, buff random'; tying them to the lamp (units next to the Phial's target) would keep the moths-drawn-to-light fantasy.

standouts.why: Primrose Apprentice puts the seed's 'each apprentice adds a line' straight into the rules, and it reads in one glance.
Burnt Ring Warden is the lamp: short text, obvious positioning, and it makes Drawn click.
The Uncertain holding the dose for gold is a clean cast-or-hold choice that also tells its joke.

weakest.why: Mortar Grinder is a stock spell-count buffer with no moth in it.
Mother Shipton's 'loses your Recipe's stats, scaled to it' takes a second read, and she does nothing with a keyword Recipe.
Atropos the honey-thief who passes by disguise ends up as a plain shop-spell discount.

flags.note: 'Every other friendly unit' can be read as alternate slots.
Copied keywords like Belly, Snap or Pack as Recipe lines have no written rulings yet.
Double casts with 10% stat scaling on one lamp compound fast; worth the owner's eye after goldens.
Burnet's line plus a Herald in F1 puts Nightshade on many enemies every fight.
